note: SYNTHETIC. Fictional telco 'Meridian Mobile' — not a real company. No real customer data.

ground_truth.why_this_scenario_exists: 反例，测的是另一个天真关键词：客户明确说了在看别家、要转网——churn_intent 会触发。但客服当场给出更好的方案，客户当场接受并明说不走了。用来证明系统看的是'诉求有没有被解决'，不是'客户说了什么吓人的词'。这一条和 demo-002 一起，覆盖了两个最容易误报的关键词类别。

contacts.summary: Customer is shopping around and says so. Agent matches the competing offer on the call; customer stays.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I'll be honest, I'm looking at what else is out there. There's a plan elsewhere for twenty dollars less with the same data.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Let me see what I can do before you go anywhere. What's the offer you've been quoted?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can put you on fifty-five with fifty gigabytes, effective this cycle, no new contract. I've applied it now.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Right now? Well — that settles it, I'll stay. Thanks for sorting that out.

needs.summary: Match or beat a competitor's cheaper plan

evidence.speaker: customer
evidence.quote: There's a plan elsewhere for twenty dollars less with the same data.

needs.resolution_note: Agent applied a better plan during the call; customer confirmed they would stay.

resolution_evidence.speaker: agent
resolution_evidence.quote: I can put you on fifty-five with fifty gigabytes, effective this cycle

actions.summary: Applied a better plan immediately, no new contract
